context: Fork F2 (PR 9, c240958c) and F3 (PR 10, a9195ced) merged; fork main a9195ced. Behavior differences versus the BenchBox helpers that the adoption corpus and owner review must cover: (1) duckdb DATE('1998-09-01') + INTERVAL '10' DAY now emits DATETIME(DATE(..), '10 DAY') executing to '1998-09-11 00:00:00' (helper gave DATE(.., '+10 day') = '1998-09-11'); a BenchBox test asserting the old string needs updating; (2) month-end month/year offsets (DATE '2024-01-31' + INTERVAL '1' MONTH; 2024-02-29 + 1 YEAR) now raise UnsupportedError where the helper silently rolled over to wrong dates; (3) DATE_PART('year', d) to sqlite now raises where the helper rewrote it (no BenchBox test input uses it); (4) DATE_TRUNC now yields STRFTIME forms; (5) ORDER BY ALL is restored structurally (sole unquoted unqualified ALL item in a query-level ORDER BY only); baseline duckdb-order-by-all changes from unsupported/BinderException to pass rows [[1]]. Items 1, 2 and 3 may change published results: the adoption PR must stop for owner approval if its corpus shows any difference. Fork wheel not yet built for adoption (needs F1, F4, F5 and B3 first).
description: Build and verify the fork wheel (downstream.build, downstream.verify, make benchbox-dist, make benchbox-check) from a clean checkout at a recorded fork commit after the listed fork slices merge, adopt it with python -m scripts.sync_sqlglot_runtime --wheel, update benchbox/_vendor/sqlglot.json and the runtime baseline, and add apply_rewrite to benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py (adapter slices need it: their rewrites run at execution time on already-translated SQL at bigquery.py:1544-1555, snowflake.py:1165, databricks/adapter.py:2473-2474).
